headline: Political shift: NCP leader suspended over remarks about PM Tarique
summary: The Nationalist Conservative Party (NCP) has taken disciplinary action against one of its leaders following controversial comments regarding the Prime Minister.
details: The Nationalist Conservative Party (NCP) has suspended a leader from its ranks following remarks made about Prime Minister Tarique.
The suspension comes as a party internal review of the recent comments was conducted to maintain party discipline and alignment with official stances.
While the specific content of the remarks has not been detailed in the public announcement, the party emphasized that no individual is above the party's guidelines.
The NCP leadership has reaffirmed its commitment to maintaining a professional and respectful discourse within the political landscape.
caption:
A high-ranking NCP leader has been suspended. The reason? Controversial remarks about the Prime Minister.

The Nationalist Conservative Party (NCP) has suspended a leader from its ranks following remarks made about Prime Minister Tarique.

The suspension comes as a party internal review of the recent comments was conducted to maintain party discipline and alignment with official stances.

While the specific content of the remarks has not been detailed in the public announcement, the party emphasized that no individual is above the party's guidelines.

The NCP leadership has reaffirmed its commitment to maintaining a professional and respectful discourse within the political landscape.

headline: 371 new cases as Dengue cases rise in 24 hours
summary: A sudden spike in infections has been reported across the country, increasing the pressure on healthcare facilities.
details: In a sharp increase, 371 new dengue cases were reported within a single 24-hour period.
The surge in cases highlights the ongoing challenge of controlling the mosquito-borne illness in the region.
Health authorities are monitoring the situation closely as the number of infections continues to climb.
Public health officials urge citizens to take preventive measures to eliminate mosquito breeding grounds.
